≈15 min (only when the world change is active)

When the {wiki:Nightmare Isles Mini World Change} is active, a portal opens in Darama that leads to the {wiki:Nightmare Isles}. On one of the islets, guarded by six {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps}, there is a chest of drawers that only opens for those who helped kill them. Inside is your {item:Nightmare Teddy}.
Nightmare creatures guard something very fitting to their nature...
One of the 3 possible portal locations in Darama
The {wiki:Nightmare Isles Mini World Change} must be active on your server that day.
Supplies to face Silencers, Retching Horrors, Choking Fears and Terrorsleeps
You can only open the chest of drawers if you took part in killing all **six** Terrorsleeps. If you go as a team, make sure everyone attacks each one of them.

Read the day's message to find out where the portal is and travel to the nearest city. For locations **1** (river near {wiki:Drefia}, next to the {wiki:Plague Spike}) and **2** (north of the {wiki:Devourer (Geography)|Devourer}, north coast near Darashia) go to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}). For location **3** ({wiki:Kha'labal}, in the Ankrahmun desert) you can also go by boat to **Ankrahmun** (you arrive at {npc:Captain Sinbeard}) and continue through the desert to the coordinates.

When the {wiki:Nightmare Isles Mini World Change} is active, travel to **Darama**. The portal appears in one of three places, depending on the day's message. Enter it to be teleported to the {wiki:Nightmare Isles}.

The Nightmare Isles are full of {creature:Silencer|Silencers}, {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors}, {creature:Choking Fear|Choking Fears} and {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps}. Follow the map to the islet that has the **only** Terrorsleeps.
Full map of the path to the Nightmare Teddy
Kill the **six** {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps} on the islet. You must take part in the kill of every one of them.
Anyone who does not take part in the kill of all six Terrorsleeps cannot open the chest of drawers.
Use the islet's {item:Chest of Drawers (Quest)|Chest of Drawers} to open it and receive the reward.

The islands' platforms are connected by **magic stairs that work as teleports** (like in the {wiki:Roshamuul Cistern}). To leave, go back the **same way**, platform by platform, to the point where you arrived through the portal. The wiki does not describe any other exit, so keep supplies for the return. Then walk back to the city you came from (Darashia or Ankrahmun).
Some platforms have more than ten creatures attacking you all at once: on the way back you may meet them again.
Estimated time: about 15 minutes after you reach the portal.
